judge.rationale: About half of the explanatory molecular content overlaps—GNLY and CCL5 support a cytotoxic lymphocyte state, while IGHM, CD79A, and TCL1A mark high-CD45RA B-cell subsets—but A uniquely relies on GZMB/NKG7/FGFBP2 and B on TRDC/IL2RB/PTPRC, so the incomplete-coverage ceiling of 6 applies.
